description:
Be visionary 
 
 Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ 
 
 We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.
   
 Job Description 
   
 We are seeking an experienced SAP BTP Integration Suite Developer with functional testing capabilities in SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate understands both the technical data orchestration layer within BTP and the functional flow of procurement processes within S/4HANA to independently execute, troubleshoot, and validate integration scenarios.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Design & Development: Architect and develop end-to-end integration flows (iFlows) using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management).

 Interface Mapping: Design complex data transformations (XML, JSON, Flat Files) to align S/4HANA enterprise structures with Source-to-Pay cloud platform data models.

 S/4HANA Functional Testing: Independently execute end-to-end testing by simulating and triggering business processes directly within S/4HANA (e.g., creating Purchase Requisitions, releasing Purchase Orders, posting Goods Receipts/Invoices).

 Data Validation: Verify that master data (Suppliers, Cost Centers, Gl Accounts, Material Master) and transactional data sync accurately between S/4HANA tables/OData services and Source-to-Pay cloud platform.

 Troubleshooting & Debugging: Diagnose integration failures across the entire stack—analyzing BTP runtime logs, checking S/4HANA application logs (SRT_UTIL, SM58, SLG1), and reviewing Source-to-Pay cloud platform API responses.

 Collaboration: Partner with business analysts and Source-to-Pay cloud platform IT to define test cases, build test scripts, and drive User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

 
 Required Technical & Functional Skills
 SAP BTP Integration Suite: 3–5 years of hands-on experience building iFlows, configuring adapters (OData, SOAP, IDoc, SFTP), and utilizing Groovy Script/JavaScript.

 S/4HANA Functional Competency: Working knowledge of SAP MM (Materials Management) and FI (Financial Accounting) modules.

 SAP Testing Toolset: Ability to navigate S/4HANA UIs (Fiori/GUI), use standard transaction codes (e.g., ME21N, MIGO, MIRO, BP), view database tables (SE16N), and utilize debugging/monitoring tools.

 Cloud Procurement Connectivity: Experience interfacing middleware Source-to-Pay cloud platforms (Ivalua, Coupa, Ariba) via REST/SOAP APIs and file-based transfers.

 Modern SAP Integration Protocols: Deep understanding of S/4HANA standard APIs, OData V2/V4 services, and standard Enterprise Services alongside traditional IDocs.

 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with automated testing tools or Postman for API testing.

 SAP Certification in BTP Integration Suite or S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement.

   
 Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.
 
 Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. ​
